facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch checkpoint from a list of candidate file paths with optional recursive key extraction

facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.load_state_dict_into_model: load a state dict into a PyTorch model and validate for missing or unexpected keys

facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.init_parameters_in_place: init model parameters in place using functions that mutate tensors directly
facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.init_parameters_selective: init only specific named parameters of a model with targeted initialization strategies
facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.init_parameters_kaiming: init model parameters using Kaiming initialization functions mapped to parameter paths

facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.build_MIMOHeadWrapper: build a MIMOHeadWrapper that attaches multiple heads to a trunk model using forward hooks
facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.create_MIMOHeadWrapper_with_heads: create a MIMOHeadWrapper with a list of head dicts specifying fork modules and input output keys
facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.test_MIMOHeadWrapper_forward: test the MIMOHeadWrapper forward method by passing a batch mapping and verifying output keys
facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.refactor_MIMOHeadWrapper_handle_list_inp: refactor the MIMOHeadWrapper handle_list_inputs logic to support list inputs beyond the vision field
facebookresearch_omnivore/omnivision/mod.review_MIMOHeadWrapper_head_args: review the MIMOHeadWrapper HeadArgs and TrunkFieldArgs dataclasses to understand head and trunk field configuration
